body.title: Repair incomplete code-review task attribution before assessment
body.reproduction: Submit a whole-story review packet with unchanged cross-engine regression tests. In design-review S2 attempt 2, reviewer omitted test indexes 19–22 as another story's tests despite exhaustive attribution instructions. Host rejected the mapping; all eight tasks became failed without assessment.
body.rootCause: attributionPrompt requires every test but does not explicitly distinguish regression evidence from changed-source scope. deriveTaskAssignments detects missing coverage but emits a generic combined error without omitted indexes or paths. Native output host validation terminates the session; the coordinator has no attribution-only correction loop and caches the shared failure for remaining tasks.
body.fixIntent: Make unchanged/cross-engine regression evidence explicitly attributable without expanding source scope; identify omitted entries precisely; allow a bounded correction cycle for invalid shared attribution using pointed host feedback, while preserving exhaustive validation, accepted assessments and native/controller semantics. Do not retry unrelated CLI or assessment failures or alter provider-wide behavior.
